name: @gusnips/infra
description: Server checks, log policies, encrypted backups, disk alerts and certificate sync

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && chmod +x dist/cli.js
scripts.lint: eslint src scripts tests && for file in jobs/*.sh tests/*.sh; do bash -n "$file" || exit; done && shellcheck -x --source-path=SCRIPTDIR jobs/*.sh tests/*.sh
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run format:check && bun run release:check
